stop_rules: No modification of frozen RC6 paper, submission, provenance, spatial generator or NAAMP analysis paths.
Do not use global GloBI, GBIF, EarthEnv, NWI, ERA5 or JRC rows as a same-pond stage-specific predation measurement.
No source-blind response reuse: NAAMP post-hoc interspecific H1 exploration is not prospective confirmation.
No published mechanism language when measured hydroperiod, stage/predation exposure and event-level detection are absent.
A same-year egg predation event cannot causally explain an earlier adult chorus from that cohort.
Primary NPS green→wood directional acoustic suppression H1A not supported; do not post-hoc retune taxon, lag or window to obtain negative coefficients.
Carroll source metadata alone is not an acquired workbook or a verified adult-to-larval repeated-measures panel.
